title: Outreach email skill config
description: Configuration passed to any skills/outreach/<skill>/SKILL.md at render time. The skill owns the email STRUCTURE and VOICE; this config supplies the SUBSTITUTABLE values (tone, CTA, sender identity, extra variables). Mirrors OutreachSkillConfig in orchestrator/src/jobs/outreach/types.ts.

skill.description: Which skill under skills/outreach/ renders the email.

cta.description: The single call to action the email closes on.
examples: a quick reply if this is relevant

sender.description: Sender identity the skill signs off as. The Gmail draft is created under `email`.

email.description: The account the draft is created under (matches GMAIL_SENDER).

signature.description: Verbatim sign-off block appended by the skill if provided.

variables.description: Arbitrary extra template variables a skill may reference (product name, offer, event, etc.). Never used to inject facts about the recipient.
